name: Heal
summary: Restores 70 Hit Points to a creature and ends Blinded, Deafened, and Poisoned.

stats.effect: Choose a creature that you can see within range. Positive energy washes through the target, restoring 70 {ref:glossary/hit-points}. This spell also ends the {ref:condition/blinded}, {ref:condition/deafened}, and {ref:condition/poisoned} conditions on the target.
stats.higherLevels: The healing increases by 10 for each spell slot level above 6.
